description: Add VAT to a price, or take it back out of one — the sum people get wrong. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

amount.description: The price. The net (pre-VAT) price when direction is add; the gross (VAT-inclusive) price when it is remove.

direction.description: add works out the VAT on a net amount and the gross that results. remove takes a gross amount and divides the VAT back out to find the net and the VAT it contained.

rate.description: The VAT rate as a percentage: 25 means 25%. Must be below 100.

name: vat_calculator
title: VAT Calculator
